record.reason: Dato presents a task-based programming model/runtime for dataflow accelerators, with programming abstractions and evaluation on accelerator workloads. Its contribution is general programmability and execution of dataflow tasks; no LLM/transformer inference optimization is established in the paper. Link to FPGA spatial LLM inference is an architectural adjacency, but too indirect for a concrete paper followup.
record.title: Dato: A Task-Based Programming Model for Dataflow Accelerators
